QuestInfo.name: [Knight Stronghold] Versus Chief Knights
QuestInfo.0: #bNeinheart#k, in the #bSecret Grove#k, has a request.
QuestInfo.1:
Neinheart requested I defeat the #rfive Chief Knights#k to weaken the Cygnus Knights.

#e#bDefeat the Chief Knights in Cygnus (Normal).
QuestInfo.2: You successfully eliminated the Chief Knights.

0.0: The most powerful knights, the Chief Knights, are always by the Empress's side. There are five in total: Mihile, Irena, Oz, Eckhart, and Hawkeye.

yes.0: The battle won't be easy. In their new forms, the Chief Knights have gained great power. Be careful.

0.1: So long as the Empress has the Chief Knights, defeating her will be next to impossible. I leave this task to you.

1.0: What happened to the Chief Knights?

yes.0: ...Good work. It must have been tough.
yes.1: I'm not sure if this what they wanted all along--to stay close to the Empress until the very end...

mob.0: You haven't defeated the Chief Knights yet. They can be found near the Empress.
